dialogs.text:
Where should this patch set's chart go? | You loaded the patch set external_patchset.ti1.

A profile project is open: R2-Engine. Where should the chart these patches make be built?

What each button does:

  •  Replace run 1: Build the chart into run 1. That run's current chart, measurement and printer profile — together with every folder inside it, including its reports and verifications — move to runs/run1/old/ first, and the new chart is saved in runs/run1/. Nothing is deleted. Everything moves because a new chart no longer matches the measurement, profile or checks made from the old one.

  •  Build it as a new run instead: Build the chart in a brand-new run of R2-Engine instead, so everything in run 1 stays exactly as it is. The Profile-run bar moves to the new run.

  •  Replace only the chart: Swap the chart in run 1 and leave everything else standing: the measurement, the profile, the reports and the verifications stay put, and nothing moves to old/. ChromIQ cannot check that these patches are the ones your measurement was taken with — only you can, and if they are not, the run keeps a measurement that no longer matches its chart. No chart settings file was found beside it, so only the patches are replaced and the settings now on screen decide the layout.

  •  Start a new project: Start a fresh profile project from these patches. You'll be asked for the project name (pre-filled as external_patchset — change it or keep it). The current project R2-Engine is left untouched; the new project gets its own folder and its own run 1.

  •  Cancel: nothing is opened, copied or changed, and the file you picked is left exactly as it is.
